posts.text: Financial ratios for Banking sector evaluation — Adding to neha’s list, a few more that matter specifically for private vs PSU comparisons: ROA and ROE : ROA (around 1% is decent for a bank) is the cleaner comparison, since banks run on high leverage and ROE alone can flatter a thinly capitalised bank. Cost-to-income ratio : operating expenses / net total income. Private banks usually run leaner; PSU banks carry higher staff and pension costs. Provision coverage ratio (PCR) : how much of the gross NPA is already provided for. Two banks with the same GNPA can look very different once you check…
